title: `output_format='python'` produces an invalid string literal when the SQL contains backslashes
spec:
This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

```python
import sqlparse
sql = "select '\\foo\\'"   # the SQL text is: select '\foo\'
print(sqlparse.format(sql, output_format='python'))
```
Expected:
```
sql = 'select \'\\foo\\\''
```
Actual:
```
sql = 'select \'\foo\\''
```
That is not even valid Python.

Other output formats and similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
